title: Four questions every homepage answers, in order
concept: A homepage must answer four questions in order: what is this, is it for me, can I trust it, what do I do next. Each slide pairs a weak answer with a strong one for an invented bicycle repair shop.
hook: Four questions every homepage answers, in order.
signature_move: A hand-drawn ring starts on the cover and carries across the seam onto slide 2.

captions.instagram:
Your homepage has to answer four questions, in this order.

1. What is this?
2. Is it for me?
3. Can I trust it?
4. What do I do next?

Most sites lead with number four. A visitor who can't answer the first one never reaches the rest.

Try it on your own site: cover everything below the first screen and ask a stranger what they would say to each. Fix the first question that fails.

Which one does yours miss?
